data.name: Mrittika
data.long_meaning:
One who defies death. In Hindu mythology, Mrittika was the name of a divine nymph who, despite her name, was immune to death.
The god of death, Yama, was infatuated with her and pursued her relentlessly. She managed to escape his grasp by wearing the leaves of the Tulsi plant, which made her invisible to him.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and determination against adversity.
